user stories are a new way of communication in OOADARE approach, and that they are used to automate the analysis of the object-oriented application.

the user stories template for object oriented applications.
the development of a new user story template for OOA and OOD phases.
the following issues: - How to automate the analysis of objects and actions from user stories?
